fact: A joint PARIS21, AFRISTAT and COMESA mission carried out the mid-term evaluation of the SNDS 2020-2024 in December 2022, and the strategy was being revised and aligned to the government roadmap with a 2023-2025 action plan.
title: Atelier de formation des cadres du SSN sur la révision de la SNDS 2020-2024 et l’élaboration du Rapport national sur le soutien à la statistique (Country report on support to statistics CRESS)
